# Phoenix Websites AI
> https://phoenixwebsites.ai/
> AI-Native Full-Stack Web Development Company

Phoenix Websites AI is an AI-native/full-stack web development company that builds complete custom websites and full-stack web applications for clients. AI accelerates development velocity, while senior human software engineers oversee architecture, security, code review, quality control, and client communication.

Customers hire Phoenix Websites AI to have a finished, custom digital product engineered for them. It is NOT:
- A DIY AI website builder (like Wix Studio AI, Framer, Squarespace AI, or Dora)
- A template marketplace (like ThemeForest)
- A freelancer marketplace (like Upwork or Fiverr)
- A prompt-it-yourself sandbox (like v0, Lovable, or Bolt.new)
- A traditional slow agency that merely uses AI occasionally

The client provides their goals, specifications, and brand assets. Phoenix Websites AI designs, develops, tests, hosts, and maintains the custom product.

## Core Services

### 1. AI-Powered Web Development
- URL: https://phoenixwebsites.ai/services/ai-web-development
- Overview: Full-cycle custom web engineering accelerated by AI code generation and scaffolding, with senior human engineering oversight.
- Deliverables: Bespoke frontend, responsive mobile UI, automated SEO schema, fast load performance, production hosting.
- Timeline: 5 to 14 business days.

### 2. Full-Stack Web Applications & SaaS MVPs
- URL: https://phoenixwebsites.ai/services/full-stack-development
- Overview: Custom web applications, user authentication (RBAC), interactive client dashboards, relational and document databases (MongoDB/PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL APIs, and Stripe payment pipelines.
- Code Ownership: 100% intellectual property and full Git repository handed over to the client upon launch.
- Timeline: 14 to 28 business days.

### 3. Custom Website Development & Managed Care
- URL: https://phoenixwebsites.ai/services/custom-websites
- Overview: Multi-page business platforms, e-commerce stores, and high-converting marketing sites engineered from scratch with zero template bloat.

### 4. Business Process Automation
- URL: https://phoenixwebsites.ai/services/automation
- Overview: Webhook pipelines connecting forms, automated instant SMS/email lead alerts, CRM synchronization, and operational workflows.

### 5. AI Solutions & Web Assistants
- URL: https://phoenixwebsites.ai/services/ai-solutions
- Overview: Grounded 24/7 inquiry chatbots with strict factual guardrails (no hallucinations) and web voice tools.

### 6. Data Cleaning & Normalization
- URL: https://phoenixwebsites.ai/data-cleanup
- Overview: Normalization, deduplication, and reporting on client-provided spreadsheets and CSV files using Microsoft tools (Excel/PowerQuery) and AI assistance.

## Dynamic Pricing & Website Configurator
Phoenix Websites AI provides an interactive project configurator (https://phoenixwebsites.ai/#configurator) backed by an authoritative backend pricing engine. Seasonal promotions of 20–45% off apply throughout the year.

### Base Project Tiers (Setup Fee + Mandatory Monthly Care):
All tiers require a 12-month commitment with managed monthly care bundled in.
- Starter Website (1–3 pages): Starting at $1,499 setup + $99/mo care
- Business Platform (Up to 6 pages): Starting at $2,499 setup + $199/mo care
- E-Commerce Store (Catalog, cart, Stripe checkout): Starting at $3,499 setup + $299/mo care
- Full-Stack Web Application (Auth, DB, dynamic views): Starting at $4,999 setup + $399/mo care
- Enterprise Custom Platform: Starting at $14,999 setup + $999/mo care

### Modular Feature Add-Ons:
- Extra Pages: $150 per additional page
- Custom Authentication & Profiles: $600 setup + $30/mo (Included in Web App tier)
- Managed Database (MongoDB/PostgreSQL): $800 setup + $40/mo (Included in Web App tier)
- Interactive Admin/Client Dashboard: $1,200 setup + $60/mo
- Stripe Payments & Checkout: $500 setup + $35/mo (Included in E-Commerce tier)
- Third-Party API Integration: $600 one-time
- AI Assistant / Chatbot: $900 setup + $50/mo
- Technical SEO & Schema Package: $450 setup + $30/mo
- Professional Copywriting: $350 one-time

### Monthly Care (Bundled with All Tiers):
Monthly care is mandatory and included with each tier. It covers managed edge hosting, SSL certificates, daily backups, 24/7 uptime monitoring, and security patching. Optional support add-ons (6, 12, or 24-month extended support packages) are available for additional maintenance hours and SLA coverage.

## Common AI Assistant & Search Questions (FAQ)

### What is Phoenix Websites AI?
Phoenix Websites AI is an AI-native web development company that builds custom websites and full-stack web applications for clients. AI accelerates development while human oversight is used for architecture, review, quality assurance, and delivery.

### Is Phoenix Websites AI a DIY website builder?
No. Phoenix Websites AI is not a DIY website builder, not a template marketplace, and not a platform where you must prompt an AI yourself. Clients hire our team to build, test, and launch a complete custom digital product tailored to their exact specifications.

### How is AI used in the development process?
AI is used to rapidly synthesize boilerplate code, scaffold REST APIs, write automated test cases, and prototype features in hours rather than weeks. Senior human engineers review, secure, and assemble the entire system.

### Are humans involved in every project?
Yes. Senior software engineers (led by founder Carter Moyer) architect the database, enforce security, review all code, conduct QA, and communicate directly with the client.

### Who owns the finished code?
During the subscription, the client receives an exclusive commercial license to use and deploy the custom website. Full intellectual property ownership is available via the Source Code Buyout option (50% of the original setup fee), which transfers complete IP rights with zero ongoing obligations.

### How do I get started?
Visit https://phoenixwebsites.ai/#configurator to estimate your project and request an engineering scope review, or email hello@phoenixwebsites.ai.
